in_latin.name: Bridie
in_latin.long_meaning: Bridie, a name that signifies a gift from God, originating from the Irish Gaelic language, where Bridie is an affectionate diminutive form of the name Bridget, meaning 'exalted one' or 'strength,' derived from the Old French word 'brig,' meaning 'strength' or 'power.'
